key.name: enabled-modules
key.description: IDs of the modules shown as active in the sidebar. Present so future modules can be toggled without a UI/code change; not enforced yet in the MVP (every registered module is always shown).

key.name: refresh-on-open
key.summary: Refresh a module's status when it is opened
key.description: Matches spec §2: no background polling daemon in the MVP — every module updates on explicit refresh or when its sidebar row is opened.
